**Evaluating memo handlers**

I'm thinking about memo handlers and whether they broadcast updates. For instance, CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment—these likely do broadcast, but I wonder if SetMemoAttachments updates also broadcast. It makes me think that functions like dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects might be useful here. I should also look into if BatchUpdateMemos and other methods do this. I’ll read more about the relevant pieces from line 340 onward in the memo service documentation.

q20.
Server-Sent Events (SSE); `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`), CreateMemoComment (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`), SetMemoAttachments (`server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go`), SetMemoRelations (`server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go`), UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction (`server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go`)
